okamoto_anomaly_resolution.the_anomaly: VQUAD-PIII-NORMALIZATION-MAP (2026-05-02) recorded that (1/6,0,0,-1/2) fails the Okamoto parameter constraint for PIII(D6) and parked it as an unresolved 'convention residual'.
okamoto_anomaly_resolution.claimed_resolution: The constraint fails BECAUSE the point is not PIII(D6). Once relabeled to doubly-degenerate PV on D5^(1), the anomaly dissolves -- there is no PIII constraint to satisfy. The 2026-05-02 anomaly is thus an INDEPENDENT second witness (via the Okamoto constraint) to the same defect VQ-N1 diagnosed via the delta-normalization / coalescence-locus route.
okamoto_anomaly_resolution.verification_required_before_relying: Confirm the exact form of the Okamoto/Sakai parameter constraint for the D6^(1) surface (the relation asserted as alpha+alpha+beta+beta=0 must be checked against Okamoto 1987 / Sakai 2001) AND confirm (1/6,0,0,-1/2) genuinely violates it. If confirmed: include as corroboration. If the constraint form differs: DROP this corroboration; the PV/D5^(1) verdict still stands on legs 1-4 via the delta-normalization route.

verification_outcome.reason: (1/6,0,0,-1/2) are DLMF standard-form PV parameters (alpha,beta,gamma,delta); DLMF 32.2(ii) confirms delta=-1/2 is the canonical PV normalization and delta=-1 the PIII normalization. The asserted 'alpha+alpha+beta+beta=0' is an Okamoto SYMMETRIC-FORM (affine-root) constraint in DIFFERENT coordinates (DLMF 32.2(v) / Okamoto a_i parameters), not the standard-form quadruple. Applying a symmetric-form sum-constraint to standard-form coordinates is a coordinate-category mismatch, so the 'violation' is not well-posed as stated. The exact D6^(1) symmetric-form constraint form could not be confirmed from available sources (Okamoto 1987 page ref still PENDING per leg1). Per VERIFY-FIRST fallback, the corroboration is DROPPED, not asserted unverified.
verification_outcome.verdict_impact: NONE. PV/D5^(1) classification stands on leg1 (DLMF 32.2(ii) delta-normalization), leg2 (DLMF 32.2.32-33 coalescence-locus exclusion), leg3 (VERIFIED-FROM-FILE surface geometry, no z^(1/2) ramification => D7 excluded, D5^(1) confirmed), leg4 (VERIFIED-FROM-FILE closeout).
